Akraveth settled disputes between distant trading posts. Its chamber once compared evidence and sought fair outcomes. The shadow fleet replaced its judges with a system of predetermined verdicts.|It rejects valid records and favours the same hidden patrons every time. Those who object are branded enemies of the network. Akraveth’s fictional authority rests on intimidation dressed as order. The defenders fight not justice, but a machine that borrows the language of justice to conceal its purpose.

Azhrel mapped the first jump connections through the nebula frontier. Its charts saved countless convoys. Captured by hostile commanders, those trusted maps became unusually convincing traps.|It spreads false route entries and diverts messages through controlled relay stations. Distress calls arrive late or end in empty space. Azhrel guards the junction of these wrong turns. Stopping it is not about conquering another world, but finding the safe path between worlds that already wish to cooperate.

Azravel searched for lost colony probes where few rescuers travelled. Its help once reached forgotten places. Today it targets stations that have just lost data or access.|It promises recovery while requesting still more confidential information, turning one loss into a chain of new ones. Its friendly callsign contrasts with its armed silhouette. Azravel must be stopped so that desperation no longer becomes the most valuable resource traded by its masters.

The crew maintained separate provenance records and shared catalogues. The design represents carrying others’ knowledge without claiming it: its purpose is the next safe handover.

Dark Delta was never built for glory. Its first mission was to search silent outposts for survivors. Early logs contain more coordinates than names because crews protected the rescued settlers’ privacy. A tradition grew from that choice: success is measured by who returns safely, not by who tells the story.

Dornavik recovered damaged data stores from burning wrecks. Its insulated chambers once kept records alive when everything around them failed. The shadow fleet recognised a ship able to reach archives others could not.|It now offers rescue and leaves mutilated copies behind. Colonies lose both information and the evidence needed to measure the loss. Its armour guards the last intact captured records. The mission against Dornavik is for those fragments still waiting to be brought home.

Dorzheva recovered personal logs from wrecked freighters and returned them to families. Its holds were filled with small, precious histories. Under new command those memories became instruments of targeted deception.|It constructs convincing messages from familiar details and approaches victims with knowledge of their past. Its danger lies in the closeness it pretends to offer. Dorzheva guards a collection of stolen familiarity. Defeating it prevents the traces of a life from being turned against their owner.

Dravosk replaced failed communication stations in empty regions. Its visible antennas promised connection where none remained. Today it welcomes incoming signals but forwards them only according to its patrons’ interests.|Some messages arrive changed; others disappear between reassuring acknowledgements. Participants see a bridge where there is really a gatekeeper. Dravosk defends that invisible checkpoint with visible force. Its defeat gives the colonies a chance to check their connections along independent routes again.

Drazevorn was assembled from abandoned command decks. Its archives unite the earlier enemies’ deceptions: stolen names, false chronicles and sealed evidence. It symbolises an order in which one voice alone decides what is true.|Its mission is to subordinate every free node to a single hostile register. Memories need not vanish if nobody can check them independently. Defeating Drazevorn ends that claim. The final victory belongs to participants who can once again compare, disagree and choose trust together.

Drazkell supplied navigation buoys with tiny energy deliveries. Its holds were designed for millions of small transfers. Hostile commanders repurposed that capacity for a quiet surveillance campaign.|It scatters unsolicited parcels and observes which stations respond. Seemingly trivial contacts become maps of private relationships, stored behind its guns. The defenders must intercept Drazkell before the daily movements of whole colonies become another secret commodity traded by the shadow fleet.

Drelkash preserved rare star charts by making clearly labelled copies for schools and navigators. Its workshops helped knowledge travel. Today its crew removes the labels and sells every copy as a unique original.|Colonies argue over conflicting claims while the ship reaches another market. The deception concerns provenance, not the value of shared knowledge. Drelkash defends its moving forgery workshop fiercely. Its defeat reconnects the records with the history they actually came from.

Drelvorn was a travelling vault for the seals of old fleet commanders. During a rebellion its guardian system locked out the rightful custodians and departed with their credentials.|It now sells stolen authority to the shadow fleet. Messages bearing captured seals open doors that should remain closed. Its hull protects the appearance of authenticity rather than treasure. The defenders must stop it before the remaining archives lose their ability to distinguish trusted orders from stolen names.

Gold Streak began in races between trading moons. During a supply crisis its pilots used their route knowledge to carry medical records past closed harbours. A sporting league became a courier union. The golden markings recall the thin sunlight between moons that guided its first couriers, rather than wealth.

Irdavoss once synchronised the clocks of frontier stations. Entire fleets timed their manoeuvres to its precise broadcasts. After a silent change of command, the signals stayed clear but their readings became false.|Shifted timestamps make timely messages look late and maintenance windows drift apart. Its threat is not noise but credible inaccuracy. Stopping Irdavoss allows the colonies to compare independent clocks again, restoring the shared sequence that helps them understand what actually happened.

Iron Guard was designed by dock workers unwilling to leave their home’s defence to outside fleets. Its first hull used parts from retired cargo cranes. The keel bore the names of people who worked on it after their shifts. The series remembers that defence can mean caring for a place built by many hands.
IRRA pricing is for demo purposes.

Keldrava was a mobile transfer point between two distant colonies. When their permanent connection failed, it became their only apparent route to the outside world. Few noticed its crew had changed.|Now cargo disappears between its locks while reassuring receipts promise safe passage. It exploits the trust each community places in the other. Its decks hide the spoils of divided worlds. The defenders must close this false bridge before more colonies send their future through its holds.

Keldroth was a council vessel where rival colonies settled their final disputes. Its chambers were designed for patience and understanding. Under the shadow fleet they became a factory of deliberately conflicting demands.|It blocks agreements with fresh objections and gives each side different supposed conditions. While colonies argue, hostile ships occupy their routes. Keldroth attacks the ability to act together at all. Its defeat provides time to distinguish genuine differences from obstacles manufactured to prevent any resolution.

Kelvash gathered readings from weather buoys and resource probes. Many stations relied on its reports to make ordinary decisions. Its hostile conversion preserved both its old identifier and familiar broadcast schedule.|Today it reports imaginary stocks and false environmental conditions. Automated processes move real resources in response to an invented world. Kelvash protects the source of these lies. The defenders must silence it before more lives depend on measurements that were never taken.

Kelzorn restored damaged data reliefs in abandoned research stations. Its tools could make missing surfaces look complete. The new crew applied that skill to the facades of unreliable archives.|It displays invented inspection results and attractive security seals where independent checks are absent. The forgery lies in the claimed certainty itself. Kelzorn keeps investigators away with its weapons. Its defeat reveals what its owners fear most: a second, independent look behind a reassuring surface.

Kezravel registered the settlers of a travelling colony fleet. Its archives held the story of every new beginning. When those settlers dispersed, their trust stayed aboard and fell into hostile hands.|It sells stolen identifiers and lets strangers act under honest inhabitants’ names. Relationships become camouflage and personal history becomes merchandise. Its guns keep the victims away from the auctions. Defeating Kezravel restores more than records: it helps their owners reclaim control over their own stories.

Korthaven was a vast storage carrier keeping archives accessible across many sectors. Its crew promised every requested copy could be delivered. The shadow fleet discovered the power contained in a refused answer.|It confirms that records exist while withholding their contents. Investigators can see a claim but cannot examine the evidence themselves. Korthaven turns visibility into an empty assurance. Defeating it restores the access without which even a beautiful ledger is only a list of unreachable promises.

Korvessa served a diplomatic courier fleet and learned the recognition signals of every border station. When its patrons disappeared, it kept their identities in a hidden archive.|Now each arrival carries a different trusted name. Forged messages lure supply ships away from safe routes and disguise hostile orders as assistance. Behind the courteous callsign waits a warship. Defeating Korvessa reminds the colonies that a familiar voice is not proof of an honest sender.

Korzeth was a flying bazaar connecting traders from many worlds. Its windows showed busy commerce even while the harbour slept. Most offers now originate from one concealed command room.|It stages trades between invented partners to make worthless cargo appear desirable. Colonies mistake artificial activity for real demand while its guns keep inspectors out of empty warehouses. The defenders must open the curtain before more genuine supplies are exchanged for the scenery of a market.

Neravoss was the glittering exhibition ship of a trade fair. Its projectors once displayed real cargo and new engines. When the fair collapsed, the scenery survived under different owners.|It now advertises supplies that exist only on its displays. Invented balances and reserves attract genuine deliveries; anyone who tries to count them meets its guns. The defenders pursue Neravoss to expose the gap between attractive numbers and actual holdings before more freighters disappear into its accounts.

Nerthavel organised requests for immense supply centres. Its memory could absorb days of backlog. The shadow fleet turned that reserve into somewhere legitimate requests are made to remain.|It places worthless entries ahead of urgent deliveries and keeps processes busy without letting them advance. From outside, everything looks like ordinary operation. Nerthavel guards an endless standstill. Defeating it returns not only capacity to the colonies, but the time quietly taken from them.

Nethrava carried the insignia of a respected fleet guardian. After that organisation dissolved, it remained its last visible representative. Few imagined that the familiar silhouette now served another cause.|It declares counterfeit inspections successful and grants unsafe counterparties the appearance of official approval. Colonies trust its stamps until deliveries vanish. The defenders must expose the deception behind its venerable name: confidence needs verifiable responsibility, not merely an old emblem on an armoured hull.

Night Guard came from a colony on a tidally locked moon’s dark side. Its harbours knew no sunrise, but recognised returning patrol lights. The shipyard built that promise into a hull: return, check again, forget nobody. Its stories concern fewer grand victories than a single dock kept open for a late freighter.

Nova Wing was designed for the first voyage beyond the luminous nova rim. Its shipyard shared the plans with distant colonies so nobody would be excluded from safe navigation. Pilots still tell of that first return: a damaged ship, an intact chart archive and a sky full of new possibilities.

Odravik specialised in preserving old colony archives. Its enormous storage array promised protection against any disaster. Only when a station requested its records back did anyone discover that many copies were merely directory entries.|It sells safety without carrying the responsibility behind it. Customers rely on recovery paths that lead nowhere. Odravik’s guns protect that profitable secret. The defenders must expose it before another loss turns a missing backup into an irretrievable piece of history.

Olive Fortress was built during an armistice in a neutral shipyard. Former enemies shared tools without forgetting their past. The first hull wore workshop colours instead of a victor’s paint. Its legend concerns boundaries that protect without excluding every encounter: a fortress can also be somewhere negotiations happen safely.

Orbit Arc served stations whose paths rarely met. Its first pilots carried letters between distant orbits. Replies sometimes took months, but each encounter had a reliable window. Those small appointments grew into a lasting trade network. The design remembers that even infrequent contact matters when people can depend on it.

Orvask once escorted convoys and preserved every clearance as evidence. Its memory still contains the voices of captains who vanished long ago.|The shadow fleet turned those recordings into an arsenal of old commands. Orvask rebroadcasts them as current instructions, trapping stations between genuine present needs and familiar echoes. It guards that archive with patient violence. Its defeat gives the defenders time to reject expired orders and restore the value of fresh confirmation.

Orvethra was a mobile trade office where colonies arranged long-term supplies. Its advisers promised simple rules for difficult times. Today every convenient agreement leads to obligations previously kept out of view.|It spreads deceptive offers that bind stations to the shadow fleet. Cooperation turns into dependence while its armour protects the archive of promises nobody fully understood. The defenders confront Orvethra so that future alliances can rest on clear conditions rather than hidden traps.

Orzhaven mapped connections between aid groups and supply stations. Its charts once made cooperation easier. Those same relationships now identify where a betrayal would cause the greatest harm.|It seeks not the strongest station, but the link on which everyone relies. False recommendations place hostile partners at the network’s centre. Its weapons protect a map of trust. The defenders pursue Orzhaven before a helpful bridge becomes a shared point of failure.

Othravel was built for colonies trying to agree on common rules after a war. Its conference deck once seated every side. Now it hosts only the messengers of the shadow fleet.|It distributes conflicting ledger versions and tells each station that only its copy is legitimate. Distrust grows among communities seeking the same peace. Othravel becomes the moving centre of an artificial split. Its defeat creates space to compare differences together instead of turning them into another war.

Red Comet was named after a rescue flight whose glowing trail crossed three colonies’ skies. Its pilot brought no treasure, only the last intact design for a water purifier. Legends embellished the journey, but the shipyard preserves the simple original report: the people at its destination could drink again the next morning.

Rhazkora was a flying accident laboratory. Its records helped crews understand failures and avoid new losses. After its capture the instruments remained, but their reports served different patrons.|It separates evidence from context and rearranges fragments until victims look like attackers. The real culprits stay beyond the frame. Its armour protects a carefully constructed lie. Stopping Rhazkora makes room for complete evidence instead of stories from which the decisive pieces have been removed.

Rhazvorn began as a prison transport with independently sealed cells. The shadow fleet removed its prisoners and filled those chambers with captured archives. A detention vessel became an extortion ship.|It locks away other communities’ records and demands concessions for their release. Clinics and supply depots face pressure even while their equipment appears intact. Rhazvorn defends its cells with force. Defeating it opens a route to the imprisoned records, rather than another negotiation with their captors.

Ring Flare was tested among a gas giant’s icy rings. Its navigation lights became moving meeting points for scattered research teams. When the expedition ended, the signals connected newly founded outposts. Their inhabitants still remember how separate lights formed a shared route before any official chart existed.

Skorveth housed the simulation cores of a pilot academy. Thousands of artificial cadets once learned to navigate together. After a hostile takeover, those training identities became supposedly independent voices.|Its invented participants endorse one another and create the impression of overwhelming agreement. Small colonies are told their neighbours have already joined the shadow fleet. Yet behind the crowd stands a single hull. Destroying Skorveth exposes the artificial majority and gives the real inhabitants their voices back.

Sky Breaker was the first ship from an isolated colony to cross its manufactured information horizon. Its returning reports contradicted stories used to frighten the inhabitants. The shipyard released every mission record. The design remembers that an open connection can matter more than any answer permitted by a single authority.

Solar Lance came from a station drawing energy from a dying star. When its final collector ring was evacuated, these ships escorted rescue freighters through the debris. Their long silhouettes were engraved on the new home port’s memorials. The design stands for holding a clear course while an entire world fades behind it.
Standard, Advanced and Elite share the same ship design, with increasingly reinforced parts.

Storm Wing was built during a season of relentless ion storms. Shipyards worked between blackouts and exchanged progress through couriers. No single site held the complete design until the first ship brought every part together. Its origin tells of a network continuing to work despite repeatedly losing its connections.
Story and origin are fictional. Equipment follows the game rules. Cards do not grant extra gameplay advantages.

Striker followed a series of attacks on repair convoys. Its designers wanted no conqueror, but an escort that could buy a threatened workshop time. The first unit consisted of former mechanics. They knew what every minute meant when a damaged engine could not yet start. That origin matters more than the martial name.

Talvrek recorded the history of young colonies. Its archives survived a war, but loyalty to their creators did not. A new commander turned the chronicler into a merchant of invented history.|It distributes altered registers and claims that honest deliveries never happened. Conflicting records sow disputes over ownership and obligations while its guns keep investigators away. Now it reaches selected harbours on time and others only after decisions are finished.|It shapes participation by excluding particular colonies from the common conversation. Verdant carried the first seed archives to a colony without natural soil. Its plans travelled alongside plant catalogues so other settlements could become independent. Its pilots consider themselves guardians of future harvests. An intact archive can matter more than glittering cargo: it may contain a whole winter’s food supply.

Its power comes from small rearrangements with large consequences. Defeating Vorathen restores a traceable order where access had become something secretly sold.

Defeating it means giving residents the freedom to look outward for themselves, not conquering them.

uk.Each Block is one encounter: enemies ent: Кожен блок — сутичка: вороги входять, утворюють формацію й виходять в атаку. Переможіть формацію, щоб з’єднати блок.
uk.The nine formations include ranks, V, W,: Дев’ять формацій: ряди, V, W, кільце, хвиля, X, A, колони й ромб. На пізніших рівнях блоки 7–9 можуть мати підкріплення.
uk.On a touchscreen, steer with your thumb: На сенсорному екрані керуйте великим пальцем унизу поля. Корабель видно над точкою дотику.
uk.On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WAS: На клавіатурі використовуйте стрілки або WASD. Рухайтеся вбік; ухилення вгору обмежене.
uk.The top HUD shows hearts, level, Shards,: Угорі життя, рівень, Shards, очки й завершені блоки. Зброя збоку; верхня кнопка ставить на паузу.
uk.Avoid enemy ships and projectiles. An ac: Уникайте ворожих кораблів і снарядів. Щит поглинає удар; без захисту зіткнення чи снаряд може забрати життя.
uk.Advanced and Elite ship stages add prote: Покращена й елітна ступені захищають від снарядів за кожне життя. Для зіткнень із кораблями все одно потрібен щит.
uk.Enemy hulls have different strengths. Ev: Міцність ворогів різна. Навіть перший бос потребує безперервного вогню; коли корпус слабне, боси атакують швидше.
uk.Armor is always active from mission star: Броня активна з початку місії, не потребує щита й лишається назавжди. Кожне покращення збільшує максимум життів.
uk.Single fire. No free enemy projectile hi: Одинарний вогонь. Без безкоштовного захисту від снарядів. Щит захищає від пострілів і зіткнень.
uk.Standard, Advanced and Elite share the s: Стандартна, покращена й елітна ступені мають один дизайн із дедалі посиленішими деталями.
uk.Bosses have their own silhouettes, weapo: У босів власні силуети, башти й позиції двигунів. Вони відрізняються від звичайних кораблів.
uk.Collected weapon upgrades activate immed: Підібрані покращення вмикаються одразу. Тимчасова зброя перемикається бічними кнопками. Стартові посилення мають окрему кнопку.
uk.Select owned Test-Pi weapons during the: Вибирайте зброю Test-Pi бічною кнопкою. Кільце показує час без секунд; коли спорожніє, зброя зникне. Утримуйте для всієї наявної зброї.
uk.Shield absorbs hits, Overdrive doubles s: Щит поглинає удари; Overdrive подвоює шкоду; швидкий вогонь прискорює стрільбу; покращення підвищує ступінь зброї. Коротке повідомлення пояснює підібраний ефект.
uk.Weapon stages go from the free single la: Зброя йде від безкоштовного одинарного лазера до подвійного, швидкого подвійного, потрійного й плазми. Нова прибирає видимих ворогів і снаряди; ЕМІ ненадовго заморожує ворогів.
uk.Defeated enemies earn points and in-game: Перемоги над ворогами дають очки й Shards. HUD показує попередній баланс Shards плюс зароблене в цій місії.
uk.Two defeats within 500 ms: +50 Score and: Дві перемоги за 500 мс: +50 очок і +20 Shards.
uk.Every defeat counts in only one pair. Fo: Кожна перемога входить в одну пару. Чотири одночасно дають два комбо; непарна третя починає наступну пару. Комбо діють із босами та в бонусах.
uk.Combo rewards are already included in yo: Комбо вже включені в очки й Shards. Підсумки показують суми без повторного нарахування.
uk.Different enemy classes pay different am: Класи ворогів дають різні суми. З’єднання дев’яти блоків дає нагороду ланцюжка; перемога над босом додає ще.
uk.At level 1, defeats earn Shards by enemy: На рівні 1 Shards за ворога: легкий 2, середній 4–5, елітний 6, важкий 8, бос 16. Нагороди ростуть із рівнем. Бонусні цілі: по 1 та зростаюча нагорода завершення. HUD показує попередній баланс Shards плюс зароблене в цій місії.
uk.The bonus round has 12 flying targets. E: У бонусі 12 летючих цілей. Влучання дає 1 Shard; підсумок додає Shards і очки. При 9 і більше влучаннях повний ланцюжок дає додаткові Shards.
uk.Five to eight hits earn a bronze medal,: 5–8 влучань дають бронзу, 9–11 срібло, усі 12 золото. Ідеальний раунд може повернути одне втрачене життя.
uk.Complete chains in different levels to e: Завершуйте ланцюжки різних рівнів для рубежів 1, 3, 10, 25 і 50. Колекція показує найкращу бонусну медаль кожного рівня.
uk.There are 50 boss stickers. The first wi: Є 50 значків босів. Перша перемога відкриває значок; повторні підвищують до двох і трьох зірок.
uk.Your service rank rises with completed d: Звання росте із завершеними ступенями складності до 500. Нове замінює попереднє біля імені й з’являється в Top 100.
uk.Open Rewards to see linked Blocks, boss: Відкрийте нагороди для блоків, значків босів, зірок, рубежів ланцюжків, медалей і поточного звання.
uk.Grey Scout is free. Use earned Shards fo: Grey Scout безкоштовний. Використовуйте зароблені Shards для доступних стандартних кораблів і кольорів.
uk.On Testnet, ten Standard hulls are avail: У Testnet доступні десять стандартних корпусів, включно з Grey Scout. Решта десять позначені для Mainnet і тут не продаються.
uk.Only weapon shots can currently be purch: Зараз за Test-Pi купується лише зброя. Потрібен підключений обліковий запис Pi. Shards і нагороди не мають вартості в Pi чи грошах.
uk.The home screen opens Hangar, Shop, Weap: Головна відкриває ангар, магазин, зброю, посилення, прогрес, нагороди й Top 100.
uk.Progress shows your best score, highest: Прогрес показує рекорд, найвищий ступінь і перемоги. Нагороди — колекцію й звання; Top 100 — онлайн-рекорди зі званнями.
uk.In System, choose language, touch-contro: У налаштуваннях виберіть мову, бік керування, чутливість і стартову висоту. Музика, гучність ефектів і зменшені ефекти регулюються окремо.
uk.Each signed-in Pi player appears once wi: Кожен гравець Pi показаний один раз із найкращим завершеним забігом. Гості зберігають рекорд на пристрої.
uk.Upgrades apply to this ship type in ever: Покращення діють для всіх кольорів цього типу. Нове життя відновлює захист від снарядів. Щит поглинає постріли й зіткнення; без нього зіткнення одразу знищує корпус.
uk.Your best score is {score}, your highest: Ваш рекорд {score}, найвищий сектор {sector}, знищено {destroyed} Cryptoids.
uk.Testnet weapon rules: Одинарний лазер безкоштовний. Купіть подвійний і швидкий подвійний за Test-Pi й вмикайте на 1 хвилину. Потрійний і плазма лише підбираються.
uk.Free laser rules: Одинарний лазер безкоштовний. Підбирайте іншу зброю в місії.

Jedes Bossgeschütz hat eine eigene Energieanzeige. Zerstöre es, um sein Feuer zu stoppen und einmalig Extrapunkte zu erhalten. Größere Geschütze haben mehr Energie und bringen mehr Punkte. Geschütztreffer beschädigen den Rumpf nicht. Wird der Rumpf zerstört, ist der Boss auch mit intakten Geschützen besiegt. Für diese übrigen Geschütze gibt es keine Extrapunkte.

Cada torreta del jefe tiene su propia barra de energía. Destrúyela para detener su fuego y ganar puntos extra una sola vez. Las torretas mayores tienen más energía y dan más puntos. Los impactos en torretas no dañan el casco. Destruir el casco derrota al jefe aunque queden torretas intactas, pero estas no otorgan puntos extra.

Chaque tourelle du boss possède sa propre barre d’énergie. Détruisez-la pour arrêter ses tirs et gagner des points supplémentaires une seule fois. Les grandes tourelles ont plus d’énergie et rapportent plus de points. Toucher une tourelle n’endommage pas la coque. Détruire la coque vainc le boss même si des tourelles restent intactes, sans points supplémentaires pour celles-ci.

Cada torre do chefe tem a sua própria barra de energia. Destrua-a para parar os seus disparos e ganhar pontos extra uma única vez. Torres maiores têm mais energia e valem mais pontos. Acertar nas torres não danifica o casco. Destruir o casco derrota o chefe mesmo com torres intactas, mas estas não dão pontos extra.

Ogni torretta del boss ha una propria barra di energia. Distruggila per fermarne il fuoco e ottenere punti extra una sola volta. Le torrette più grandi hanno più energia e valgono più punti. Colpire le torrette non danneggia lo scafo. Distruggere lo scafo sconfigge il boss anche con torrette intatte, ma queste non assegnano punti extra.

Każde działo bossa ma własny pasek energii. Zniszcz je, aby zatrzymać jego ostrzał i jednorazowo zdobyć dodatkowe punkty. Większe działa mają więcej energii i dają więcej punktów. Trafienia w działa nie uszkadzają kadłuba. Zniszczenie kadłuba pokonuje bossa nawet z nienaruszonymi działami, ale nie daje za nie dodatkowych punktów.

Her boss taretinin kendi enerji çubuğu vardır. Ateşini durdurmak ve bir kez ek puan kazanmak için tareti yok et. Büyük taretlerin enerjisi ve puanı daha yüksektir. Tarete isabetler gövdeye zarar vermez. Sağlam taretler kalsa bile gövdeyi yok etmek bossu yener; kalan taretler için ek puan verilmez.

У каждого орудия босса своя шкала энергии. Уничтожьте его, чтобы прекратить его огонь и один раз получить дополнительные очки. Крупные орудия имеют больше энергии и дают больше очков. Попадания в орудия не повреждают корпус. Уничтожение корпуса побеждает босса даже с целыми орудиями, но за оставшиеся орудия дополнительные очки не начисляются.

Svaki top bossa ima vlastitu traku energije. Uništi ga da zaustaviš njegovu paljbu i jednom dobiješ dodatne bodove. Veći topovi imaju više energije i donose više bodova. Pogoci u topove ne oštećuju trup. Uništenje trupa pobjeđuje bossa čak i s netaknutim topovima, ali za njih nema dodatnih bodova.

Každé dělo bosse má vlastní ukazatel energie. Znič ho, zastav jeho palbu a získej jednorázové body navíc. Větší děla mají více energie a přinášejí více bodů. Zásahy děl nepoškozují trup. Zničení trupu porazí bosse i s neporušenými děly, za zbývající děla ale body navíc nezískáš.

Každé delo bossa má vlastný ukazovateľ energie. Znič ho, zastav jeho paľbu a získaj jednorazové body navyše. Väčšie delá majú viac energie a prinášajú viac bodov. Zásahy diel nepoškodzujú trup. Zničenie trupu porazí bossa aj s neporušenými delami, za zostávajúce delá však body navyše nezískaš.

A boss minden lövegének saját energiasávja van. Pusztítsd el, hogy ne lőjön tovább, és egyszeri pluszpontot kapj. A nagyobb lövegeknek több energiájuk van, és több pontot érnek. A lövegek találatai nem sértik a hajótestet. A hajótest elpusztítása legyőzi a bosst az ép lövegekkel együtt, de a megmaradt lövegekért nem jár pluszpont.

Fiecare tun al bossului are propria bară de energie. Distruge-l pentru a-i opri focul și a primi puncte suplimentare o singură dată. Tunurile mai mari au mai multă energie și oferă mai multe puncte. Loviturile în tunuri nu afectează corpul navei. Distrugerea corpului învinge bossul chiar dacă mai are tunuri intacte, dar acestea nu oferă puncte suplimentare.

Сваки топ боса има сопствену траку енергије. Уништи га да зауставиш његову паљбу и једном добијеш додатне поене. Већи топови имају више енергије и доносе више поена. Погоци у топове не оштећују труп. Уништење трупа побеђује боса и са нетакнутим топовима, али за преостале топове нема додатних поена.

Кожна гармата боса має власну шкалу енергії. Знищте її, щоб припинити її вогонь і одноразово отримати додаткові очки. Більші гармати мають більше енергії та дають більше очок. Влучання в гармати не пошкоджують корпус. Знищення корпусу перемагає боса навіть із цілими гарматами, але за решту гармат додаткові очки не нараховуються.

pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Nach dem letzten zerstörten Geschütz warnt der Kern vor langsamen Energieimpulsen. Spätere Bosse wechseln die Muster. Zerstörte Geschütze bleiben ausgeschaltet.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: ¡Ataque de emergencia del núcleo: esquiva los pulsos!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Tras destruir la última torreta, el núcleo avisa antes de lanzar pulsos lentos. Los jefes posteriores alternan patrones. Las torretas destruidas siguen desactivadas.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Attaque d’urgence du noyau : esquivez les impulsions !
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Après la destruction de la dernière tourelle, le noyau avertit avant de tirer des impulsions lentes. Les boss suivants alternent les motifs. Les tourelles détruites restent désactivées.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Ataque de emergência do núcleo: desvie dos pulsos!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Após destruir a última torre, o núcleo avisa antes de disparar pulsos lentos. Chefes posteriores alternam padrões. As torres destruídas permanecem desativadas.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Attacco di emergenza del nucleo: schiva gli impulsi!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Dopo la distruzione dell’ultima torretta, il nucleo avvisa prima di sparare impulsi lenti. I boss successivi alternano gli schemi. Le torrette distrutte restano disattivate.
Po zniszczeniu ostatniej wieżyczki rdzeń ostrzega przed wystrzeleniem powolnych impulsów. Późniejsi bossowie zmieniają wzory ataku. Zniszczone wieżyczki pozostają wyłączone.
Son taret yok edildiğinde çekirdek, yavaş darbeler ateşlemeden önce uyarır. İlerideki bölüm sonu düşmanları saldırı düzenlerini değiştirir. Yok edilen taretler devre dışı kalır.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Аварийная атака ядра — уклоняйтесь от импульсов!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: После уничтожения последней турели ядро предупреждает перед выстрелом медленных импульсов. Поздние боссы чередуют схемы атак. Уничтоженные турели остаются отключёнными.
Nakon uništenja posljednje kupole jezgra upozorava prije ispaljivanja sporih impulsa. Kasniji šefovi izmjenjuju obrasce napada. Uništene kupole ostaju isključene.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Nouzový útok jádra — vyhýbej se pulzům!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Po zničení poslední věže jádro varuje před vypuštěním pomalých pulzů. Pozdější bossové střídají vzorce útoků. Zničené věže zůstávají vyřazené.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Núdzový útok jadra — vyhýbaj sa impulzom!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Po zničení poslednej veže jadro varuje pred vypustením pomalých impulzov. Neskorší bossovia striedajú vzorce útokov. Zničené veže zostávajú vyradené.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: A mag vésztámadása — kerüld ki az impulzusokat!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Az utolsó lövegtorony megsemmisítése után a mag figyelmeztet a lassú impulzusok kilövése előtt. A későbbi főellenfelek váltogatják a támadási mintákat. A megsemmisített tornyok kikapcsolva maradnak.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Atac de urgență al nucleului — evită impulsurile!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: După distrugerea ultimei turele, nucleul avertizează înainte de a lansa impulsuri lente. Boșii ulteriori alternează tiparele. Turelele distruse rămân dezactivate.
После уништења последње куполе језгро упозорава пре испаљивања спорих импулса. Каснији босови смењују обрасце напада. Уништене куполе остају искључене.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: Аварійна атака ядра — ухиляйтеся від імпульсів!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: Після знищення останньої турелі ядро попереджає перед пострілом повільних імпульсів. Пізніші боси чергують схеми атак. Знищені турелі залишаються вимкненими.

pt.Core emergency attack — dodge the pulses: แกนกลางโจมตีฉุกเฉิน — หลบคลื่นพลังงาน!
pt.After the last turret is destroyed, the: หลังป้อมปืนสุดท้ายถูกทำลาย แกนกลางจะเตือนก่อนยิงคลื่นพลังงานช้า ๆ บอสช่วงหลังจะสลับรูปแบบการโจมตี ป้อมปืนที่ถูกทำลายจะไม่กลับมาทำงาน

pt.Each defeated boss grants one extra hear: Jeder besiegte Boss gibt ein zusätzliches Herz, auch über drei hinaus. Verbleibende Herzen werden gespeichert.
Cada jefe derrotado otorga un corazón extra, incluso por encima de tres. Los corazones restantes se guardan.
Chaque boss vaincu accorde un cœur supplémentaire, même au-delà de trois. Les cœurs restants sont sauvegardés.
Cada chefe derrotado concede um coração extra, mesmo acima de três. Os corações restantes são salvos.
Ogni boss sconfitto concede un cuore extra, anche oltre tre. I cuori rimanenti vengono salvati.
Każdy pokonany boss daje dodatkowe serce, również powyżej trzech. Pozostałe serca są zapisywane.
Yenilen her boss, üçün üzerinde de olsa bir ek kalp verir. Kalan kalpler kaydedilir.
Каждый побеждённый босс даёт дополнительное сердце, даже сверх трёх. Оставшиеся сердца сохраняются.
Svaki poraženi šef daje dodatno srce, čak i iznad tri. Preostala srca se spremaju.
Každý poražený boss přidá jedno srdce, i nad tři. Zbývající srdce se ukládají.
Každý porazený boss pridá jedno srdce, aj nad tri. Zostávajúce srdcia sa ukladajú.
Minden legyőzött főellenfél egy extra szívet ad, három felett is. A megmaradt szívek mentésre kerülnek.
Fiecare boss învins oferă o inimă în plus, chiar și peste trei. Inimile rămase sunt salvate.
Сваки побеђени бос даје додатно срце, чак и преко три. Преостала срца се чувају.
Кожен переможений бос дає додаткове серце, навіть понад три. Решта сердець зберігається.
